sections.title: Get all cluster alerts
sections.text:
GET /v1/cluster/alerts

Get all alert states for the cluster object.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_cluster_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_cluster_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/cluster/alerts 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| ignore_settings | boolean | Retrieve updated alert state regardless of the cluster’s alert_settings. When not present, a disabled alert will always be retrieved as disabled with a false state. (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of [alert objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) and their states.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Get cluster alert
sections.text:
GET /v1/cluster/alerts/{alert}

Get a cluster alert state.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_cluster_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_cluster_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/cluster/alerts/cluster_too_few_nodes_for_replication 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| ignore_settings | boolean | Retrieve updated alert state regardless of the cluster’s alert_settings. When not present, a disabled alert will always be retrieved as disabled with a false state. (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns an [alert object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert).

#### Example JSON body

[code example]
